body.heading: Overview
body.text: Ceylon Compass Holidays is a destination management company in Colombo. We design private round trips, day tours, beach stays and special-interest holidays across Sri Lanka, with local guides and hand-picked hotels.

body.heading: How to book
body.text: Book any published tour in a conversation with Mira or on its tour page. Prices are quoted per booking in US dollars and include everything listed under each tour's inclusions. Optional excursions are not included.

body.heading: Payment
body.text:
- Day and city tours: pay the full amount when you book.
- Multi-day tours and stays: pay a 25% deposit to confirm. The balance is due 30 days before the start. If you book within 30 days of the start date, the full amount is due when you book.
- We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express through a secure payment link. We do not accept cryptocurrency.

body.heading: Hotels
body.text: Where a tour says "or similar", we confirm the exact hotel at booking. Requests for a specific alternative hotel are priced by our team.

body.heading: Group size
body.text: Private tours are for 1 to 20 travellers. For larger groups, contact our team.

body.heading: Overview
body.text: This policy applies to all bookings made from 1 November 2026. It replaces any cancellation terms shown on older pages.

body.heading: Day and city tours
body.text: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the start. No refund after that.

body.heading: Multi-day tours and stays
body.text:
- 30 days or more before the start: full refund minus a USD 50 admin fee.
- 8 to 29 days before the start: 50% refund.
- 7 days or less: no refund.

body.heading: Overview
body.text:
- **Infants under 2** travel free. They share their parents' seat and bed.
- **Children aged 2 to 11** pay child entrance fees, half-price meals and an extra bed in their parents' room on stays.
- **Children 12 and over** pay adult rates.

This policy replaces any older family offers shown on individual tour pages.

body.heading: Are your tours private?
body.text: Yes. Every tour is private for your group, with your own vehicle and guide.

body.heading: Can you cater for dietary needs?
body.text: Yes. Vegetarian, vegan and halal meals are available on request.

body.heading: Do you offer airport transfers on their own?
body.text: Yes, from Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB) to anywhere on the island, priced by our team on request.

body.heading: Can you change a tour?
body.text: Yes. Every pre-designed tour can be customised. Our team prices custom changes.
